# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large concatenation of real inbound/outbound calls handled by Crayon Roofing & Structures (Manali/Andarkuppam, Chennai), a metal roofing-sheet manufacturer/trader. A majority of the "transcripts" are short, low-signal operational snippets (vehicle loading, bill-copy handovers, staff leave coordination, wrong-number calls, loan-telemarketing spam, system/IT troubleshooting). After filtering these out, there is a solid core of genuine sales calls: outbound cold-calls ("Crayon Roofing-ல இருந்து call பண்ணிருக்கேன், roofing sheets requirement இருக்கா?"), inbound rate/stock enquiries, dealer/distributor price negotiations, custom-fabrication orders (L-flash, cable flashing, bent sheets), and payment/PO/GST follow-ups. Rates, colors, and product mix repeat consistently enough across many different calls to be trusted as real pricing data, though prices shift daily/weekly ("price revise ஆயிருச்சு") so treat all rates below as date-stamped reference points, not fixed prices. Honesty note: there is no single "showcase" sales call with full discovery→close; most calls are mid-cycle (rate confirmation, stock check, delivery date) rather than first-contact pitches, so the playbook below is reconstructed from many fragments.

## Products & brand ladder
Crayon is **not a pure roofing-only shop** — it sells metal roofing sheets plus a wide accessory/structural catalogue:

- **Colour-coated metal roofing sheets (JSW Steel based)** — the core product. Brand ladder from premium to economy as heard on calls:
  - **Color On Plus** (top brand, most requested) — "Color On Plus தான் இருக்கு"
  - **Radiance** (JSW)
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus**
  - **Silver On** (plain/silver finish, slightly dearer than plain, "Silver On-க்கு rate கொஞ்சம் அதிகமா இருக்கும்")
  - **Asian Indra Dhanush** — mentioned as an alternate make
  - Plain/non-colour GI sheet also sold at a base rate
- **Colors available (stock-dependent, frequently out of stock):** off-white (steadiest seller), sky blue, grey/graphite grey/pencil grey/traffic grey, cauliflower green, Nova blue. Staff repeatedly tell customers "off-white மட்டும் தான் stock இருக்கு, sky blue/grey 2 நாள் wait பண்ணணும்."
- **Thicknesses sold:** 0.40, 0.45, 0.47 (most common), 0.50, 0.60, up to 0.8mm on request.
- **PUF/PIR sandwich panels** — both **roof panel** and **wall panel**, thicknesses 30mm/40mm/50mm, used for warehouse/cabin structures ("top can be the plain thing... roof and wall panel").
- **Decking sheets** (metal floor decking, 1.2mm mentioned) — production only runs when total order crosses ~30 running meters minimum batch.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** with accessories — base plates (standard 1.7m module) and turbo roof fans, sold as sets.
- **Tile-profile sheets** — sold "sample matching" basis (customer gives colour/photo sample, factory matches ridge/profile).
- **Fabricated accessories** — L-flashing, rain cutter/ridge, cable flashing, crimped/bent sheets (e.g., "4 அடி-ல 3+1 bend"), louvers (custom, by request, rate quoted after checking).
- **Hardware line** — Tata self-tapping roofing screws (1 inch, bulk cartons), nut-bolts (not stocked — "nut bolt நம்ம பண்றது இல்ல"), cutting wheels (4"/14"), welding rods, square/MS pipes (various sizes against order).
- **Checkered plate (GI, 3mm)** enquiries are redirected ("நான் இன்னொரு number தரேன்").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
*(All ₹ are per **square meter** unless noted; "+GST" is almost always stated separately.)*

- Color On Plus 0.47mm — ₹435, ₹445, ₹465 + GST quoted on different calls/dates (price moves almost daily: "ஒரு வாட்டி போக போகுது")
- Color On Plus 0.50mm — ₹475 + GST
- Off-white 0.47 — ₹445 + GST ("445 நான் 50 சொல்லிட்டேன்")
- Silver On 0.47 — ₹410–435 + GST (stock sometimes 1 week out)
- Pragathi — ₹405–435 + GST; also quoted as ₹107/unit basis in a trader-to-trader coil call; Radiance ₹113; Color On Plus ₹118/147 in similar unit
- Plain/non-colour sheet 0.47 — ₹101 + GST
- JSW heavy 0.8mm — ₹750 + GST (support/application-specific job)
- PUF roof panel 50mm — ~₹1500/sq m (standard); wall panel ~₹1450/sq m
- L-flashing (fabricated): standard 12"x12" fold = ₹650 + GST per piece (8 ft length); if customer needs 400mm x 400mm fold, rate **doubles** because of full-sheet usage ("அது double rate-ல வரும்")
- Screws — Tata 1" screw ₹120 per (large order negotiated down from ₹130); standard carton = ~7000 pieces
- Cutting wheel 4" — ₹13 + GST; 14" — ₹325 (bulk 50-carton discount offered)
- Welding rod (3.15mm) — ₹336/packet incl. GST
- Standard sheet width = 3.5 ft / 1.08 meter; length cut to customer spec up to 20–35 ft on request
- **Payment terms repeatedly stated:** 50% advance + 50% before delivery is standard; the company does **not** normally accept pure credit terms ("credit-ன்றது நம்ம இதுல accept பண்ண மாட்டோம்"); discounted quote is already the "best/discount price," further negotiation routed to "Sir"/owner approval
- Price validity is short — quotes are valid "1 day" or until next rate revision; PO/Performa Invoice raised before payment can be revised if price changes, causing repeated customer friction
